applicableAreas: overhead electric line routing along southern property boundary and front frontage
findings.comment: Landscape plan and site plan show overhead electric lines but contain no clearance dimension annotations from outer conductor to buildings, parking areas, driveways, trees, or other site features. Required plan and section view exhibits with dimensioned clearances from outer conductor to outermost edges of all site features are not provided.

applicableAreas: southern property boundary near overhead electric line
findings.comment: Landscape plan shows two mitigation trees positioned directly at or intersecting the overhead electric (OHE) line in the southeast corner of the site. No lateral clearance distance is documented between tree positions and the overhead conductor. Tree species are not verified as utility-compatible in accordance with ECM Appendix F. Per ECM § 2.4.2.C, trees within 10 lateral feet of overhead distribution conductors must be utility-compatible species; trees cannot be planted under or directly adjacent to conductors.

applicableAreas: overhead electric line clearances from buildings
findings.comment: No building elevation sheets are included in the submitted civil site plan package. Surveyed elevations of overhead electric conductors and clearance dimensions to building faces, projections, and roof lines cannot be verified from available documents. Building elevation sheets with dimensioned clearances from surveyed conductor elevations are required to demonstrate compliance.

applicableAreas: proposed structures near overhead electric lines
findings.comment: Overhead electric lines exist on the property near proposed buildings. No building elevation sheets showing surveyed conductor elevations are provided. Vertical and horizontal clearance dimensions from overhead conductors to building faces, overhangs, and roof lines cannot be verified. Engineered building elevation exhibits with dimensioned clearances are required to demonstrate minimum 7.5-foot sky-to-ground clearance compliance.

applicableAreas: site features near overhead electric lines
findings.comment: Overhead electric lines are present on the property. No plan-view radial clearance dimensions are shown from outside conductor to customer facilities, buildings, or parking areas. Conductor type (primary vs. neutral distribution conductors) is not clearly identified on electrical plans. Required dimension annotations and radial clearance verification from conductor are not provided.

No building elevation sheets showing building projections (overhangs, awnings, balconies, canopies, roof features) with clearance dimensions from overhead conductors are provided. Profile and elevation exhibits demonstrating both 7.5-foot sky-to-ground and 15-foot radial clearances from outside conductor to all building projections are required.

No clearance dimensions are visible on submitted plans to verify whether distances are measured from outside conductor or from utility pole centerline. Clearance methodology cannot be verified from available documents. All clearance dimension annotations must originate from outside conductor location, not from pole centerline, particularly on multi-conductor installations where conductors may be several feet offset from pole center.

applicableAreas: buildings and site features near overhead electric lines
findings.comment: No registered surveyor field data is provided showing existing overhead electric pole locations, conductor elevations, or mid-span clearance measurements. Survey data documenting vertical clearances from overhead conductors to proposed buildings, driveways, and other site features is not submitted. When vertical clearances appear marginal or insufficient, surveyor mid-span clearance certification is required per code.

codeCitations: Texas Health & Safety Code Chapter 752, Section 752.003
findings.comment: The 48-hour pre-construction notification requirement to Austin Energy is mentioned only in the Electric Transmission Notes section of Sheet 3, not as a general cover sheet or notes page requirement applicable to work near all overhead electric lines. Unclear whether this requirement is intended to apply to distribution line work or is transmission facility-specific. A general cover sheet or notes page requirement for notification before work near high-voltage overhead lines should be clearly stated.
